title: Spain’s Leader Rushes to Ceuta After Thousands of Migrants Burst Across Border
summary_full: Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez was set to arrive in Ceuta, a Spanish territory in Africa, amid an escalating crisis for his pro-immigration government.
